item.title: Rice rewarded, Wirtz must do more - Liverpool and Arsenal player ratings
item.description: How Liverpool and Arsenal's players rated in their Premier League match at Anfield, as the champions of the past two seasons went head to head.

item.title: Giant curiosity Hibs finally liberated from Hearts sucker punch
item.description: Hibernian, for once, avoid late heartbreak to set up League Cup final with Rangers, writes Tom English.

item.title: Are Celtic club in regression amid run of six defeats in 10?
item.description: Chris Sutton and Ian McCall weigh in on Celtic after a second league defeat of the season, but manager Martin O'Neill is defiant.

item.title: Spence 'very proud' to break WSL appearance record
item.description: Tottenham midfielder Drew Spence says it is a "very proud moment" to become the Women's Super League's all-time appearance record holder.

item.title: Defeat for London City - but is Europe a real possibility?
item.description: London City Lionesses suffer defeat by Manchester City but their performance suggests they are closer to Champions League qualification than expected.

item.title: Third choice? Inside Alexander-Arnold's struggles in Madrid
item.description: Trent Alexander-Arnold is currently third-choice right-back at Real Madrid - where does his future lie?

item.title: Are Manchester United really at risk of a relegation scrap?
item.description: Manchester United's current tally of seven points from nine games would not even get them 30 points if it was continued for the full season.

item.title: 'Everyone saw it' - Iraola confused by Isak penalty decision
item.description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola reacts to his side's defeat at home to league-leaders Arsenal, saying he "doesn't understand" why Alexander Isak was not awarded a penalty.

item.title: Bellingham & Mbappe score as Real Madrid earn statement win
item.description: Kylian Mbappe, Jude Bellingham and Yan Diomande score as Real Madrid cruise to a 3-0 win against Racing Santander, moving only three points behind Barcelona at the top of La Liga.

item.title: Arteta credits Fleetwood loss for spirited win at Anfield
item.description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta believes their loss in the League Cup to Fleetwood spurred his side on to their first victory at Anfield in 14 years.

item.title: Chelsea put six past Charlton to top WSL
item.description: Ruthless Chelsea put six goals past Charlton - who are yet to earn a point in the WSL this season - to return to the top of the table with 27 goals in just eight games.

item.title: Clinical Man City edge past London City in WSL thriller
item.description: Manchester City earn a dramatic victory courtesy of goals from Khadija Shaw and Lauren Hemp against an excellent but wasteful London City Lionesses side.

item.title: Retired Sheff Utd legend Sharp signs for Rushden
item.description: Former Sheffield United and Doncaster Rovers striker Billy Sharp comes out of retirement to join Northern Premier League side AFC Rushden & Diamonds as they prepare for their FA Cup match against Burton Albion.

item.title: Are De Zerbi's Spurs finding elusive consistency?
item.description: Are Spurs finally finding elusive consistency under Roberto de Zerbi after a third successive Premier League win, asks chief football writer Phil McNulty?
